column1: # Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0; word forms and counts only.
# Sources: fawiki (CC BY-SA 4.0), mizan (CC BY 4.0 dataset), irib-news,
# blogfa, books, persian-tweets-2024, ganjoor (licences unspecified in ingestion).
# Finite-verb gate: package verb-stems.tsv, verb-preverbs.tsv and verb-colloquial.tsv.
# Their inherited sources include standard paradigms and John Mace, Persian Grammar, Appendix I;
# the corpus behind the legacy preverb counts is unspecified. Common first-word list authored here.
# Two words joined: corpus rows, held-out documents excluded, orthography corpus-counts v1, 2026-11-09.
# 3M tokens each wiki/IRIB/Mizan, 2M blogs/verse, all available books and 2024 tweets.
# Excludes a separate document sample; tokens fold Arabic kaf/yeh and ZWNJ.
# First part: closed common non-name vocabulary or an analysed imperfective verb;
# second part: analysed finite verb. Both >=100; joined <=2; pair >=30 and >=100*joined;
# pair >=5 in at least two kinds; ambiguous splits excluded. No benchmark pairs used.
# Only word forms and counts; no source text. See data/LICENSE.
